findings.quote: Add `src/lib/supabase/errors.ts`: `toActionError(err)` that maps a PostgREST/RPC error to `{key, message}` using `@church/domain` `errors.ts` (match `message` against the catalogue keys; fall back to a generic message

findings.quote: `frame-ancestors 'none'`. Add `X-Frame-Options: DENY` on a second `headers()` entry whose `source` matches everything EXCEPT `/s/:path*` and `/embed/:path*` … for `/embed/*` also omit `frame-ancestors 'none'`
findings.problem: The CSP with `frame-ancestors 'none'` is attached to the `/(.*)` entry, so it also lands on `/s/*` and `/embed/*`; a second `headers()` entry cannot omit a directive set by the first, and browsers give CSP `frame-ancestors` precedence over `X-Frame-Options`. DESIGN §9 exempts `/s/*` and `/embed/*` from framing restrictions.
findings.fix: Use the same negative-lookahead `source` (`/((?!s/|embed/).*)`) for the CSP entry as for `X-Frame-Options`, and give `buildCsp({ frameable })` in `src/lib/security/csp.ts` a variant that omits `frame-ancestors` (or emits `frame-ancestors *`) so step 3.4 attaches the exempt routes' CSP itself. Adjust the csp.test.ts bullet to assert `frame-ancestors 'none'` only for the default variant.
